title: Pointwise affine spectrum conjugacy for termwise representatives
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime$, $g:S\prime\to S$, $g\prime:X\prime\to X$ form a cartesian square of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], with a pullback proof for the square of their spectrum global-section maps. Fix chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], objects $K,K\prime$, and $\phi:L(g\prime)^*K\to K\prime$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let $c$ be Coordinates for $\phi$ [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition] and $d$ Coordinates for its explicit spectrum transport [def-pc-affine-spectrum-derived-coordinates]. Assume $d.P=(X.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1})^*c.P$ and $d.N=(X\prime.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1})^*c.N$ as termwise complexes. For each point $z_0\in\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(X\prime,\mathcal O_{X\prime})$ and each $i\in\mathbf Z$, the additive arrows underlying stalkComparison for $c$ at $X\prime.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}(z_0)$ and for $d$ at $z_0$ are isomorphic in the arrow category of abelian groups. Neither horizontal comparison is assumed invertible.

proof.text: Naturality of isoSpec and stalkMap_comp identify the four local rings at corresponding points, intertwining all algebra structures. The two restriction equations for tensorMap and tensor universality identify the tensor-to-stalk maps. The pullback-stalk formula, natural in complexes, and the two assumed equalities identify the stalk complexes of d.P and d.N with scalar transport of c.P and c.N.

The ring isomorphisms give exact scalar equivalences. Uniqueness of the universal left-derived extension and its counit gives isomorphisms on derived tensor cohomology. Naturality for A-multiplication identifies the full A tensor_R B action. Extending to C gives the source isomorphism. Exactness of stalks gives the target homology isomorphism. Correct these identifications by the derived ratios of the representative isomorphisms e and eprime when d uses other representative isomorphisms.

The represents equations, the leftDerivedLift equation defining affineSpectrumDerivedPullbackIso, and the cohomology model comparison_eq and localized_eq equations identify the horizontal maps under these source and target isomorphisms. Naturality of tensorStalkIso gives a commuting square. Forget module scalars and use Mathlib Arrow.isoMk to obtain the asserted arrow isomorphism.
